options_page_title.description: Browser tab title of the Settings page.

options_heading.description: Main heading at the top of the Settings page.

options_loading_settings.description: Placeholder shown on the Settings page while the stored settings are being read.

options_privacy_loading.description: Placeholder in the Privacy and data section while the privacy state is being read.

options_blocking_heading.description: Heading of the Settings section that holds the block and allow lists.

options_blocking_help.message: Custom rules block during blacklist sessions. The whitelist is what stays reachable during whitelist sessions. Bundled categories block common time sinks.
options_blocking_help.description: Introduction under the Blocking heading in Settings.

options_custom_blacklist_title.description: Heading of the rules table holding the sites the person added themselves.

options_whitelist_title.description: Heading of the rules table holding the sites that stay reachable in a whitelist session.

options_bundled_categories_heading.description: Heading of the ready-made site category lists shipped with the extension.

options_bundled_categories_help.message: Bundled lists of common time sinks. Toggle a whole category, then open it to keep single sites available.
options_bundled_categories_help.description: Introduction under the Bundled categories heading in Settings.

options_schedule_heading.description: Heading of the Settings section holding the recurring session windows.

options_schedule_help.message: Sessions start on their own inside these windows. Strictness set here applies for the whole window.
options_schedule_help.description: Introduction under the Schedule heading in Settings.

options_behavior_heading.description: Heading of the Settings section holding the defaults a new session opens with.

options_budget_heading.description: Heading of the Settings section holding the earned credit that buys access to blocked sites.

options_notifications_heading.description: Heading of the Settings section holding sounds, notifications, and the toolbar badge.

options_privacy_heading.description: Heading of the Settings section holding storage, export, and deletion controls.

options_load_error_retry.description: Button that starts the background worker again after Settings failed to load.

options_load_error_delete_all.description: Button that confirms deleting all data when no retry fixes the broken profile.

options_load_error_keep_data.description: Button that cancels the delete-everything confirmation on the Settings load error.

options_delete_all_data.description: Button that opens the confirmation for deleting every piece of extension data.

options_session_status_label.description: Label of the read-only running-session line at the top of Settings.

options_rule_kind_host_badge.description: Badge on a rules table row whose pattern is a domain name.

options_rule_kind_regex_badge.description: Badge on a rules table row whose pattern is a regular expression.

options_rule_remove.description: Button that deletes one row from a rules table.

options_rule_remove_aria.description: Screen reader label of the button that deletes one rule. PATTERN holds the rule as it is shown, for example facebook.com.

options_rules_empty.description: Placeholder shown in place of a rules table that holds no rules.

options_rule_kind_aria.description: Screen reader label of the dropdown that picks between a domain rule and a regex rule.

options_rule_kind_host_option.description: Dropdown option for a rule that matches a domain name and everything under it.

options_rule_kind_regex_option.description: Dropdown option for a rule that matches the whole address as a regular expression.

options_rule_pattern_aria.description: Screen reader label of the text field that takes a new rule.

options_rule_pattern_placeholder_host.description: Greyed-out example in the rule field while a domain rule is selected. Replace it with a site that is a common distraction in your language if that reads better.

options_rule_pattern_placeholder_regex.description: Greyed-out example in the rule field while a regex rule is selected. It is a regular expression and should stay as it is.

options_rule_add.description: Button that adds the typed pattern to the rules table above it.

options_rules_help.message: facebook.com covers that domain and every subdomain. news.ycombinator.com covers that subdomain and anything under it. /youtube\.com\/shorts/ matches the full URL as a regular expression.
options_rules_help.description: Explanation under a rules table. The three examples are literal patterns and stay as they are.

options_number_error_positive.message: $LABEL$ must be a positive whole number.
options_number_error_positive.description: Error under a number field that takes only whole numbers above zero. LABEL holds that field's own label, for example Focus minutes.

options_number_error_whole.message: $LABEL$ must be a whole number of zero or greater.
options_number_error_whole.description: Error under a number field that takes whole numbers including zero. LABEL holds that field's own label.

options_number_error_nonnegative.description: Error under a number field that takes fractions including zero. LABEL holds that field's own label.

LABEL.example: Minutes of site access per 30 minutes of focus

options_number_error_minute_range.message: $LABEL$ must be within the supported minute range.
options_number_error_minute_range.description: Error under a duration field whose value is outside the minutes the extension supports. LABEL holds that field's own label.

options_number_error_day_range.message: $LABEL$ must be within the supported day range.
options_number_error_day_range.description: Error under a field counting days whose value is outside the days the extension supports. LABEL holds that field's own label.

options_session_defaults_heading.description: Heading of the group holding the values the start form opens with.

options_session_defaults_help.message: Mode and strictness are fixed when a session starts. These are the values the start form opens with.
options_session_defaults_help.description: Explanation under the Session defaults heading.

options_preset_short_label.description: Label of the field holding the first of three duration buttons on the start form.

options_preset_default_label.description: Label of the field holding the middle of three duration buttons on the start form.

options_preset_deep_label.description: Label of the field holding the longest of three duration buttons on the start form.

options_mode_blacklist_label.description: Radio label for the session mode that blocks the listed sites and allows the rest.

options_mode_whitelist_label.description: Radio label for the session mode that allows only the listed sites and blocks the rest.

options_strictness_flexible_label.message: Flexible: end the session whenever you choose
options_strictness_flexible_label.description: Radio label for the session type that can be stopped at any moment.

options_strictness_friction_label.message: Friction: stopping early uses the configured deliberation gate
options_strictness_friction_label.description: Radio label for the session type that puts a waiting step in front of an early stop.

options_strictness_hard_label.message: Hard: no early end, temporary site access only
options_strictness_hard_label.description: Radio label for the session type that cannot be stopped before its end.

options_cycle_heading.description: Heading of the group holding the focus and break lengths.

options_cycle_help.message: Defaults: 25 minute focus, 5 minute break, 15 minute long break every 4th cycle. Breaks on a schedule beat break-when-you-feel-like-it for mood and focus in study samples. The exact minutes are convention, not science.
options_cycle_help.description: Explanation under the Focus and break cycle heading.

options_cycle_default_label.message: Cycle focus and breaks by default
options_cycle_default_label.description: Checkbox that turns the focus and break cycle on for every new session.

options_focus_minutes_label.description: Label of the field holding the length of one focus block.

options_short_break_minutes_label.description: Label of the field holding the length of the break between focus blocks.

options_long_break_minutes_label.description: Label of the field holding the length of the longer break taken every few cycles.

options_long_every_label.description: Label of the field holding how many cycles pass between long breaks. N stands for that number.

options_gate_heading.description: Heading of the group holding the waiting step in front of stopping a session early.

options_gate_help.message: A 10 second wait with an explicit back-to-work button measurably reduces impulse visits (field study, PNAS 2023). The longer wait and the typed sentence roughly double the effect.
options_gate_help.description: Explanation under the Deliberation gate heading. PNAS is the name of a journal and stays as it is.

options_gate_wait_one.description: Radio label for one of the fixed waiting times of the deliberation gate. Singular. COUNT holds the number of seconds.

options_gate_wait_other.description: Radio label for one of the fixed waiting times of the deliberation gate. Plural, used for 0, 10, and 30. COUNT holds the number of seconds.

options_gate_wait_custom.description: Radio label that selects a waiting time typed into the field below it.

options_custom_delay_label.description: Label of the field holding a waiting time of the person's own choosing.

options_custom_delay_error.message: Custom delay must be a positive whole number of seconds.
options_custom_delay_error.description: Error under the custom waiting time field when the typed value is not a whole number above zero.

options_gate_typed_phrase_label.description: Checkbox that adds a sentence the person must type before a session can be stopped early.

options_gate_force_end_label.message: Enable "Ignore timeout and end anyway" button
options_gate_force_end_label.description: Checkbox that shows an escape button on the waiting step. The quoted text is the label of that button.

options_credit_help.message: Site access credit accrues while you focus. Both access to all sites and a single-site unlock spend from the same balance. You can step away at any time without spending credit.
options_credit_help.description: Explanation at the top of the Site access credit section.

options_earn_rate_label.message: Minutes of site access per 30 minutes of focus
options_earn_rate_label.description: Label of the field holding how much credit half an hour of focus earns.

options_credit_cap_label.description: Label of the field holding the largest credit balance that can be saved up.

options_pause_length_label.description: Label of the field holding how long one purchase of access to every site lasts.

options_unlock_length_label.description: Label of the field holding how long one purchase of access to a single site lasts.

options_streak_heading.description: Heading of the group holding the daily goal and how long statistics are kept.

options_streak_help.message: The streak counts days that reach the goal. One default session keeps the chain alive, and a freeze token repairs a missed day.
options_streak_help.description: Explanation under the Streak and retention heading.

options_streak_goal_label.description: Label of the field holding how many focused minutes a day must reach to count.

options_freeze_interval_label.description: Label of the field holding how often a token that repairs a missed day is granted.

options_retention_label.description: Label of the field holding how many days of statistics are kept before deletion.

options_category_on_announcement.description: Screen reader announcement after a bundled category is switched on. CATEGORY holds the category name, for example Social.

options_category_off_announcement.description: Screen reader announcement after a bundled category is switched off. CATEGORY holds the category name, for example Social.

options_all_categories_on_announcement.description: Screen reader announcement after every bundled category is switched on at once.

options_all_categories_off_announcement.description: Screen reader announcement after every bundled category is switched off at once.

options_all_sites_included_announcement.description: Screen reader announcement after every site of one category is put back under blocking. CATEGORY holds the category name.

options_all_sites_kept_available_announc.description: Screen reader announcement after every site of one category is excused from blocking. CATEGORY holds the category name.

options_category_bulk_actions_aria.description: Screen reader label of the row of buttons that select or deselect every bundled category.

options_selected_count.description: Counter of how many categories or sites are currently selected. COUNT holds the number.

options_deselected_count.description: Counter of how many categories or sites are currently deselected. COUNT holds the number.

options_select_all.description: Button that selects every category, or every site of one category.

options_deselect_all.description: Button that deselects every category, or every site of one category.

options_select_all_categories_aria.description: Screen reader label of the Select all button above the bundled categories.

options_deselect_all_categories_aria.description: Screen reader label of the Deselect all button above the bundled categories.

options_show_category_sites.description: Button that opens one bundled category to show the sites in it. CATEGORY holds the category name.

options_hide_category_sites.description: Button that closes one bundled category again. CATEGORY holds the category name.

options_category_sites_included_one.description: State line under an enabled category. Singular. COUNT holds how many of its sites are blocked.

options_category_sites_included_other.description: State line under an enabled category. Plural. COUNT holds how many of its sites are blocked.

options_category_off.description: State line under a bundled category that is switched off.

options_included_when_enabled_one.description: State line under a switched-off category. Singular. COUNT holds how many of its sites would be blocked.

options_included_when_enabled_other.description: State line under a switched-off category. Plural. COUNT holds how many of its sites would be blocked.

options_category_site_bulk_actions_aria.description: Screen reader label of the buttons that select or deselect every site of one open category. CATEGORY holds the category name.

options_select_all_category_sites_aria.description: Screen reader label of the Select all button inside one open category. CATEGORY holds the category name.

options_deselect_all_category_sites_aria.description: Screen reader label of the Deselect all button inside one open category. CATEGORY holds the category name.

options_category_sites_region_aria.description: Screen reader label of the scrolling list of sites inside one open category. CATEGORY holds the category name.

options_day_sun.description: Sunday, abbreviated to fit a small day button in the schedule.

options_day_mon.description: Monday, abbreviated to fit a small day button in the schedule.

options_day_tue.description: Tuesday, abbreviated to fit a small day button in the schedule.

options_day_wed.description: Wednesday, abbreviated to fit a small day button in the schedule.

options_day_thu.description: Thursday, abbreviated to fit a small day button in the schedule.

options_day_fri.description: Friday, abbreviated to fit a small day button in the schedule.

options_day_sat.description: Saturday, abbreviated to fit a small day button in the schedule.

options_schedule_cycles_label.description: Checkbox in the schedule entry form that turns the focus and break cycle on for that entry.

options_schedule_overlap_error.description: Error when a schedule entry shares a time with another one. DAY holds the abbreviated weekday, for example Mon.

options_schedule_session_type_aria.description: Screen reader label of the strictness radio group in the schedule entry form.

options_schedule_entry_legend.description: Caption of the form that adds or edits one recurring session window.

options_schedule_start_label.description: Label of the clock time a scheduled window opens at.

options_schedule_end_label.description: Label of the clock time a scheduled window closes at.

options_schedule_duration_legend.description: Caption of the radio group choosing how long a scheduled session runs.

options_schedule_intention_label.description: Label of the field holding what the scheduled time is meant for.

options_schedule_intention_placeholder.description: Greyed-out example in the intention field of a schedule entry.

options_schedule_save_entry.description: Button that keeps the schedule entry being edited.

options_cancel.description: Button that closes a form or a dialog without doing anything.

options_schedule_empty.description: Placeholder shown in place of the schedule list when nothing is scheduled.

options_schedule_selected_days_aria.description: Screen reader label of the weekday badges on a saved schedule entry.

options_schedule_time_range.description: The clock times of a saved schedule entry. START and END hold the times as the browser formats them.

options_schedule_mode_blacklist.description: Mode shown on a saved schedule entry: the listed sites are blocked. Lower case, it sits in a row of short values.

options_schedule_mode_whitelist.description: Mode shown on a saved schedule entry: only the listed sites are allowed. Lower case, it sits in a row of short values.

options_schedule_strictness_flexible.description: Session type shown on a saved schedule entry: it can be stopped at any moment. Lower case, it sits in a row of short values.

options_schedule_strictness_friction.description: Session type shown on a saved schedule entry: stopping early goes through a waiting step. Lower case, it sits in a row of short values.

options_schedule_strictness_hard.description: Session type shown on a saved schedule entry: it cannot be stopped early. Lower case, it sits in a row of short values.

options_schedule_enabled_label.description: Checkbox that decides whether one saved schedule entry runs.

options_schedule_edit.description: Button that opens one saved schedule entry for editing.

options_schedule_delete.description: Button that removes one saved schedule entry.

options_schedule_add.description: Button that opens an empty form for a new recurring session window.

options_sounds_heading.description: Heading of the group holding the volume and the per-event sound switches.

options_master_volume.description: Label of the slider setting the volume of every sound the extension plays.

options_sound_session_complete.description: Name of the sound played when a focus session reaches its end.

options_sound_break_start.description: Name of the sound played when a break begins.

options_sound_break_end.description: Name of the sound played when a break ends.

options_sound_schedule_start.description: Name of the sound played when the schedule starts a session on its own.

options_sound_preview_aria.description: Screen reader label of the button that plays one sound once. SOUND holds that sound's name, for example Break start.

options_sound_play.description: Button that plays one sound once so it can be heard.

options_sound_preview_error.message: Could not preview the sound. Try again.
options_sound_preview_error.description: Error shown when playing a sound once failed.

options_sounds_notifications_heading.description: Heading of the group holding the system notification switch, inside the Notifications section.

options_session_complete_notification.message: Show a system notification when a session completes
options_session_complete_notification.description: Checkbox that turns on the operating system notification at the end of a session.

options_badge_heading.description: Heading of the group holding the small label drawn on the toolbar icon.

options_badge_countdown.message: Show the remaining time on the toolbar icon
options_badge_countdown.description: Checkbox that draws the time left in the session on the toolbar icon.

options_privacy_website_access_heading.description: Heading of the privacy card holding the browser permission that lets the extension block sites.

options_privacy_website_off_title.description: State line of the website access card when the browser permission was not granted.

options_privacy_website_off_detail.message: Focus Lock cannot block websites until you grant access.
options_privacy_website_off_detail.description: Explanation under the website access state when the permission is missing.

options_privacy_website_enable_action.description: Button that asks the browser for the permission that lets the extension block sites.

options_privacy_website_unregistered_tit.message: Website access is granted, but blocking is not active
options_privacy_website_unregistered_tit.description: State line of the website access card when the permission is there but blocking did not start.

options_privacy_website_unregistered_det.message: Chrome granted access, but Focus Lock could not register its blocking script.
options_privacy_website_unregistered_det.description: Explanation under the website access state when the permission is there but blocking did not start.

options_privacy_website_retry_action.description: Button that tries to start blocking again after the permission was already granted.

options_privacy_website_on_title.description: State line of the website access card when everything is in place.

options_privacy_website_on_detail.message: Focus Lock can apply your active blocking rules on regular website pages.
options_privacy_website_on_detail.description: Explanation under the website access state when everything is in place.

options_privacy_confirm_local_history_ti.description: Title of the dialog confirming deletion of the detailed history kept on this device.

options_privacy_confirm_local_history_ac.description: Button in the dialog that carries out the deletion of the local history.

options_privacy_local_history_deleted.description: Announcement after the local history was deleted.

options_privacy_confirm_local_history_bo.message: This permanently deletes full URLs, focus intentions, and detailed session events from this device. It does not clear a running session, which keeps its intention and the address of each tab it is blocking. Ending the session clears the intention and starts a cleanup that clears every open website tab, and the cleanup removes every stored address when it completes.
options_privacy_confirm_local_history_bo.description: Body of the local history deletion dialog while statistics are also stored elsewhere.

options_privacy_confirm_local_history_bo.message: This permanently deletes full URLs, focus intentions, and detailed session events from this device, plus local-only aggregate statistics. It does not clear a running session, which keeps its intention and the address of each tab it is blocking. Ending the session clears the intention and starts a cleanup that clears every open website tab, and the cleanup removes every stored address when it completes.
options_privacy_confirm_local_history_bo.description: Body of the local history deletion dialog while the summary statistics live only on this device, so they go too.

options_privacy_confirm_synced_policy_ti.description: Title of the dialog confirming deletion of the copies left in Chrome Sync.

options_privacy_confirm_synced_policy_ac.description: Button in the dialog that carries out the deletion of the Chrome Sync copies.

options_privacy_synced_policy_deleted.description: Announcement after the copies in Chrome Sync were deleted.

options_privacy_confirm_synced_policy_bo.message: This permanently deletes remote settings, block and allow lists, site access credit, streaks, and domain-level blocked-attempt aggregates from Chrome Sync. Local settings and statistics stay on this device.
options_privacy_confirm_synced_policy_bo.description: Body of the dialog confirming deletion of the copies left in Chrome Sync.

options_privacy_confirm_all_title.description: Title of the dialog confirming deletion of every piece of extension data.

options_privacy_confirm_all_action.message: Confirm delete all Focus Lock data
options_privacy_confirm_all_action.description: Button in the dialog that carries out the deletion of every piece of extension data.

options_privacy_all_deleted.description: Announcement after every piece of extension data was deleted.

options_privacy_all_body_intro.message: This permanently deletes every piece of Focus Lock data on this device and any Focus Lock copies left in Chrome Sync:
options_privacy_all_body_intro.description: First paragraph of the delete-everything dialog, introducing the list of what goes.

options_privacy_all_body_outro.message: Deleting everything is available only while no session is running. Focus Lock then returns to setup.
options_privacy_all_body_outro.description: Last paragraph of the delete-everything dialog, under the list of what goes.

options_privacy_error_local_history_clea.message: Local history could not be deleted. Try again.
options_privacy_error_local_history_clea.description: Error shown when deleting the local history failed.

options_privacy_error_synced_policy_clea.message: Remote Chrome Sync data could not be deleted. Try again.
options_privacy_error_synced_policy_clea.description: Error shown when deleting the copies in Chrome Sync failed.

options_privacy_error_all_clear.message: All Focus Lock data could not be deleted. Try again.
options_privacy_error_all_clear.description: Error shown when deleting every piece of extension data failed.

options_privacy_error_sync_write.message: Chrome Sync could not save your latest changes. Your local save is safe.
options_privacy_error_sync_write.description: Error shown when Chrome Sync refused a write while the copy on this device went through.

options_privacy_error_request.message: The request could not be completed. Try again.
options_privacy_error_request.description: Error shown when a privacy action could not reach the background worker.

options_privacy_website_access_updated.description: Announcement after the browser granted the permission that lets the extension block sites.

options_privacy_website_access_denied.description: Announcement after the browser permission request was turned down.

options_privacy_error_website_access.message: Website access could not be updated. Try again.
options_privacy_error_website_access.description: Error shown when asking the browser for the blocking permission failed.

options_privacy_website_blocking_enabled.description: Announcement after blocking started on a second attempt.

options_privacy_error_export.message: Could not export the event log.
options_privacy_error_export.description: Error shown when the background worker returned no usable event log.

options_privacy_error_export_retry.message: Could not export the event log. Try again.
options_privacy_error_export_retry.description: Error shown when saving the exported event log to a file failed.

options_privacy_error_open_chrome_settin.message: Could not open Chrome permission settings. Try again.
options_privacy_error_open_chrome_settin.description: Error shown when the browser's own permission page could not be opened.

options_privacy_chrome_settings_opened.description: Announcement after the browser's own permission page opened in a new tab.

options_privacy_open_chrome_settings.description: Button that opens the browser's own permission page for this extension.

options_privacy_sync_heading.description: Heading of the privacy card holding the switch that copies data between devices.

options_privacy_sync_switch_label.message: Sync Focus Lock data across Chrome devices
options_privacy_sync_switch_label.description: Label of the switch that copies extension data between the person's Chrome installations.

options_privacy_sync_enabled.description: Announcement after copying data between devices was turned on.

options_privacy_sync_disabled.description: Announcement after copying data between devices was turned off.

options_privacy_sync_saving.message: Chrome Sync is still saving your latest changes.
options_privacy_sync_saving.description: State line while a write to Chrome Sync is still on its way.

options_privacy_sync_on.description: State line of the Chrome Sync card while copying between devices is on.

options_privacy_sync_off.description: State line of the Chrome Sync card while copying between devices is off.

options_privacy_sync_changes_saved.description: Announcement after a retried write to Chrome Sync went through.

options_privacy_retry_enable_sync.description: Button shown when the very first attempt to turn on Chrome Sync failed.

options_privacy_retry_sync.description: Button that sends the pending changes to Chrome Sync again.

options_privacy_scope_synced.description: Heading of the list of data that is copied between devices.

options_privacy_scope_local_only.description: Heading of the list of data that never leaves this device.

options_privacy_developer_note.message: Nothing is sent to the Focus Lock developer.
options_privacy_developer_note.description: Reassurance at the bottom of the Chrome Sync card.

options_privacy_local_log_heading.description: Heading of the privacy card holding the export and the local history deletion.

options_privacy_local_log_detail.message: Export the detailed local log or delete local browsing and session history.
options_privacy_local_log_detail.description: Explanation under the Local event log heading.

options_privacy_export_local_log.description: Button that saves the detailed local log to a file.

options_privacy_local_log_exported.description: Announcement after the detailed local log was saved to a file.

options_privacy_delete_local_history.description: Button that opens the confirmation for deleting the detailed history kept on this device.

options_privacy_remote_data_heading.description: Heading of the privacy card holding the deletion of the copies left in Chrome Sync.

options_privacy_remote_data_detail.message: Delete the Focus Lock copies left in Chrome Sync without changing this device.
options_privacy_remote_data_detail.description: Explanation under the Remote Sync data heading.

options_privacy_delete_remote_data.description: Button that opens the confirmation for deleting the copies left in Chrome Sync.

options_privacy_all_data_heading.description: Heading of the privacy card holding the deletion of every piece of extension data.

options_privacy_all_data_detail.description: Explanation under the All Focus Lock data heading.

options_privacy_resuming_all_clear.message: Resuming deletion of all Focus Lock data.
options_privacy_resuming_all_clear.description: Announcement after a stuck delete-everything was picked up again.

options_privacy_retry_local_history.description: Button that tries the failed deletion of the local history again.

options_privacy_retry_remote_sync.description: Button that tries the failed deletion of the Chrome Sync copies again.

options_privacy_retry_all_data.description: Button that tries the failed deletion of every piece of extension data again.

options_error_refresh_privacy.message: Could not refresh privacy settings. Reload the page.

options_pending_waiting.description: Line under a Settings control holding a change a hard lock refused. VALUE is the value the person chose, such as a duration or a site name.

options_pending_cancel.description: Button that drops a change a hard lock is holding, so it will not be applied when the lock ends.

options_pending_value_on.description: The value of a held change that turns a Settings switch on. Read inside 'Waiting for the hard lock to end'.

options_pending_value_off.description: The value of a held change that turns a Settings switch off. Read inside 'Waiting for the hard lock to end'.
